findings.issue: The ?N regex rewrites placeholders inside SQL literals/comments and drops anonymous placeholders when mixed with numbered ones. Valid SQL can fail or silently bind NULL instead of the supplied value.
The positional mapper silently discards surplus bind arguments (SELECT ?1 with two values succeeds), hiding binding defects that SQLite/D1 reject.

README and docs/ci-admission.md still describe Actions budget admission failure as current. Read-only GitHub API checks confirm successful real check steps for main@31f7131 (run 34690640060, attempt 2) and this exact PR head (run 36695770634, attempt 2), both completed 2026-10-05.
The historical successful local test result has no candidate SHA, despite issue #6 requiring results to be bound to the tested revision; only the failing base SHA is recorded.

summary: Fixed four defects: SQL placeholder parsing, silent excess bindings, stale Actions status, and missing candidate-SHA evidence. Regression tests failed before each fix; all seven gate scripts now pass on Node 22.19.0 and 26.7.0.
